Big Idea (Understanding)

🌿 8.1 Basic Sources of Materials

Everyday objects are made from materials that come from different natural sources, and understanding their origins helps us use these resources responsibly.

Real-life situation from the sheet: Students use plastic bottles every day to carry drinking water to school. Choosing reusable water bottles instead of throwing away single-use bottles helps conserve petroleum, a limited natural resource, and reduce plastic waste.

🧰 8.2 Properties of Materials

The properties of materials determine their suitability for different purposes, helping us choose the right materials to meet our everyday needs.

Real-life situation from the sheet: The metal part of a cooking pot becomes hot, while its heat-resistant handle remains cooler. Choosing a material that does not conduct heat easily for the handle helps prevent burns and makes cooking safer.

♻️ Think responsibly: choose materials for their intended use, reuse objects when possible, and reduce unnecessary waste of natural resources.
